p1_4_timing_mt_vs_mn.finding: Lane 'rerun_post_mn' cho MT (duoc code gan trong so boost 1.15x, ghi vao moi bundle qua truong lane_fusion_policy) KHONG con xay ra tu 2026-07-01 (67 ngay truoc), va = 0 lan trong 30 ngay qua. Prompt/mo ta hom nay CHUA duoc dump tu ham dang serve (RM-14) nen KHONG the ket luan MT ai_chain co doc duoc ket qua MN da cong bo hay khong — chi xac nhan duoc THU TU THOI GIAN: ai_chain MT bat dau SAU khi MN da co ket qua that.

p2_5_baseline_and_rates.method: Sao chep dung logic get_all_tails() (database.py:2400) va check trong verify_prediction() (database.py:2919-2929): bt_hit=1 neu bt_number (so dau tien model chon, zfill 2) trung mot trong CAC duoi 2 so cua TAT CA giai (khong chi tail_db/tail_g8) tren TAT CA dai cua mien-ngay do. nen k1 = trung binh(so duoi PHAN BIET/ngay)/100, tinh tren du lieu that 2026-08-08..2026-09-06.
p2_5_baseline_and_rates.cross_check_verdict: KHONG KHOP: neu nen k=1 do duoc (0.4367/0.3493/0.2393 cho MN/MT/MB) la dung, thi cong thuc RM-18 cho k=2 phai ra 68.3%/57.7%/42.1%, deu CAO HON nhieu so voi 34,0% da cong bo. NOT PROVEN ly do lech — co the con so 34,0% dinh nghia cho mot loai cuoc khac (vd can DUNG CA 2 so cung trung, khong phai 'it nhat 1 trong 2'), hoac tinh tren mot pham vi du lieu/mien khac. CAN tim lai dinh nghia goc truoc khi dung 34,0% lam nen cho phep do bach-thu-mot-so nay (RM-11/RM-18).
p2_5_baseline_and_rates.multiple_comparison_note: 81 phep so sanh dong thoi, ky vong ~4 phep vuot |z|>=2 THUAN TUY DO NGAU NHIEN (alpha=0.05 x 81 ~= 4). Do do CHI 3/81 vuot |z|>=2 KHONG DU de ket luan bat ky model-mien nao thuc su lech nen — phai ghi NOT PROVEN cho tung cap, kho khong chi mot phep.

p2_6_trend_two_halves.verdict: CHUA DUOC PHEP KET LUAN xu huong (RM-04): moi nua chi co toi da 15 mau nhi phan, SE ~ 12-13pp o muc nen 30-45%, nen mot buoc nhay 30pp+ van nam trong khoang 2-2.5 SD — co the xay ra do ngau nhien voi xac suat khong nho khi xet dong thoi 81 cap. 5/81 cap nhay >=30pp: khong the goi la 'model dang tot len' hay 'dang xau di' voi bang chung nay.
